env TARGET=$WORK/.codex/skills
env SRC=$WORK/source

# Install both skills
exec axen source add $SRC
exec axen install source --targets=codex --skills=skill_a,skill_b
exists $TARGET/skill_a/SKILL.md
exists $TARGET/skill_b/SKILL.md

# Remove skill_a
exec axen remove source --skills=skill_a
! exists $TARGET/skill_a/SKILL.md

# Check lockfile namespace still exists because skill_b is there
grep '"source"' .axen/axen-lock.json

# Remove skill_b
exec axen remove source --skills=skill_b
! exists $TARGET/skill_b/SKILL.md

# Check lockfile namespace is removed because of new prompt logic
! grep '"source"' .axen/axen-lock.json

-- source/skill_a/SKILL.md --
name: skill_a
-- source/skill_b/SKILL.md --
name: skill_b
-- source/axen.json --
{"axen_version":"1","name":"mysrc","skills":{"skill_a":{"path":"skill_a"},"skill_b":{"path":"skill_b"}}}
